exposure: Maternal age: 35-39 years (advanced maternal age group)
Maternal age: >40 years (very advanced maternal age group)
outcome: Spontaneous preterm delivery before 34 weeks of gestation
Admission to the neonatal intensive care unit requirement
cohort: 757 nulliparous women with singleton pregnancies who underwent routine mid-trimester fetal ultrasonography between January 2011 and July 2015 at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, University of Cukurova School of Medicine.
finding: Advanced maternal age is a risk factor for gestational diabetes mellitus, gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, small for gestational age infants, spontaneous late preterm delivery, and cesarean section.
mod_finding: Advanced maternal age was found to be a risk factor for cesarean section.
